cmd.file.save_copy: Save a copy for someone else…
cmd.file.save_copy.desc: Saves a copy of the project without AI consent and, unless you choose otherwise, without the AI journal. This project stays as it is.
ai.copy.title: Save a copy
ai.copy.journal: Include the AI journal in the copy? The journal holds requests, answers and addresses. Cloud consent is never copied: the other person decides for themselves. Choose No to leave the journal out.
ai.copy.same: Choose another file: a copy cannot replace the open project.
